name: Generic AIVSS Decision Point
definition: A generic decision point for AI-Specific Vulnerability Scoring System (AIVSS) metrics based on the 0.5 paper.

values.name: None / Not Present
values.definition: The agent does not possess this characteristic.

values.name: Partial / Limited
values.definition: The characteristic is present but constrained or limited.

values.name: Full / Unconstrained
values.definition: The characteristic is a primary, fully-enabled feature.
